target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md §108
review_type: read-only design disposition and source review
summary: §108 now closes the principal capacity finding at the policy level: in-memory degraded is insufficient; durable catalog quarantine is required before releasing the case lock; catalog failure is global fail-closed; startup checks quarantine before DB/sidecar open; quarantined cases cannot accept new commands or reset the chain. It also correctly requires tool_started without tool_result to recover pending_unknown. Implementation remains blocked because no supervisor/catalog implementation is present in the reviewed store source, Windows ACL and directory durability are still explicit integration gates, and the path-based helper does not consume an OpenVerified handle. New residuals: the crash/restart behavior after catalog quarantine persistence fails is unspecified, and the current validator allows terminal_failed to carry reserved commit_unknown/rollback_proven result classes in some phases.

prior_finding_dispositions.evidence: docs/41 §108:114 explicitly rejects in-memory degraded as authorization state, requires durable catalog quarantine before lifecycle-lock release, global fail-closed on catalog write/Sync failure, and startup quarantine validation before DB/sidecar open. No catalog/supervisor implementation was found in server/internal/store; the helper remains memory-only at lines 189-192.
pilot_start_sidecar.go lines 94-115 performs Lstat then a separate pathname OpenFile and post-open type/mode check, without verified-handle input/file-ID comparison.
§108:114 marks Windows ACL verification outstanding; pilotSidecarModePrivate returns true on Windows at lines 136-140.
§108:114 marks Windows parent-directory durability outstanding; syncPilotSidecarParent is a Windows no-op at lines 143-155.
§108:114 restricts creation to supervisor-verified new cases, but createPilotStartSidecar still accepts only path/key at lines 80-88.

§108:116 requires pending_unknown without tool_result; nextPilotStartPhase excludes phases 3/5 from terminal_failed (lines 366-377,392-396). However validatePilotStartEvent at lines 327-329 permits terminal_failed with result_class commit_unknown or rollback_proven.

findings.title: Crash after failed durable quarantine write has no restart disposition
findings.evidence: §108:114 requires global fail-closed and lock retention while alive if catalog write/Sync fails, but startup only checks persisted quarantine state. A zero-byte failed catalog append can leave the old valid chain with no quarantine marker, so restart cannot infer that the capacity-triggered quarantine attempt failed.
findings.required_action: Define a durable independent recovery marker or conservative startup/manual-review rule for this uncertain condition; add crash/restart acceptance proving the case cannot reopen as healthy after quarantine persistence failed.

findings.title: terminal_failed accepts reserved commit_unknown/rollback_proven result classes
findings.evidence: pilot_start_sidecar.go:327-329 checks valid result class and excludes only ok for terminal_failed. Its transition function permits terminal_failed in phases 1,2,4,6,7,13,14 at lines 392-393, so reserved result classes can pass before their matching event transitions.
findings.required_action: Explicitly reject result_class commit_unknown and rollback_proven for terminal_failed; only matching event types may carry them, with negative event validation cases.

remaining_conditions: Implement catalog-backed quarantine, startup pre-open authorization, and coordinator restart integration.
Define crash/restart behavior after quarantine append/Sync failure with no durable marker.
Implement OpenVerified identity/link checks and new-case-only create authorization in the supervisor caller path.
Complete Windows DACL and parent-directory durability integration.
Reject reserved result classes on terminal_failed in code.
limitations: No tests or runtime validation were run.
No supervisor, catalog, filesystem, ACL, durability, path-race, or restart behavior was executed.
The reviewed sidecar helper is pilot_e2e build-tagged; no claim is made about production-route reachability.
